observations: Single hub: 5 of 6 HTTP routes (all except route:GET /) dispatch into one ToDoService singleton (todo_service.py, fan-out 12), built at import time in api.py via the hand-written composition root factory.py. There is no FastAPI Depends(); tests reach the service by patching the module global.

toDo has exactly one DML writer (repository.py), a clean persistence choke point. But the schema has two authorities: DDL comes from 2 create_all() callers (main.py, init_db.py) on the declarative Base, while reads and writes go through a separately defined Table on another MetaData (2 definitions of the same table). Consolidate before any port.

Client-cache coupling: the 'todos' query cache has 3 writers (the mutation hooks) and 4 readers, all keyed to a hardcoded page 1 / limit 10 that matches TodoList. Any pagination change touches 5 modules at once.

Cross-tier seam: 4 of 6 routes have a frontend caller. No frontend caller for route:GET /, route:GET /todo/{todo_id} (the e2e readiness check polls /docs; todoApi.getById exists but is never called). TS contract types are hand-mirrored in types/todo.ts. The REST contract is the natural migration seam, and generating types from OpenAPI would remove the drift risk.

DI resolution: ToDoService.input_sanitizer <- InputSanitizer wired at backend/app/factory.py:24, but self.input_sanitizer is never used. So the keyword sanitizer is reached only through FieldValidator's own instance. repository.py reaches database.py only through the injected safe_session_scope (no import).

Dead-end candidates: backend/app/config.py, frontend/src/components/common/LoadingOverlay.tsx. No unresolved dynamic dispatch was found (the uvicorn string target and every HTTP call resolved), so these are not suppressed.

Import-root split: init_db.py imports through `app.*` after a sys.path hack while everything else uses `backend.app.*`. The same module can then load twice under two names; normalise it before restructuring packages.

flows.name: Capture a new todo
flows.description: Someone types a task and presses Enter; it appears at once and is saved on the server.

steps.label: Types a title and presses Enter (checked: not empty, at most 255 characters)
Shown in the list instantly, before the server answers
Sent to the server with a browser-generated ID
Server checks the text; titles with words like 'or' or 'update' are rejected
Saved to the database
List refreshes from the server (or the instant entry is rolled back on error)

flows.name: Review my todo list
flows.description: Someone opens the app and sees their todos; only the first 10 are ever shown.

steps.label: Opens the app in the browser
List asks for page 1, 10 items
Request goes to the server
Server loads todos not marked deleted (no sort order)
Each todo is shown with Edit and Delete buttons

flows.name: Rename a todo
flows.description: Someone edits a todo's title; the change shows at once and is saved.

steps.label: Clicks Edit and types a new title
Change shown instantly
Sent to the server
Server re-checks the text (same keyword rules)
Saved; the 'updated' timestamp is not refreshed
List refreshes from the server

flows.name: Delete a todo
flows.description: Someone deletes a todo after confirming; it disappears but is only flagged as deleted in the database.

steps.label: Clicks Delete and confirms the prompt
Removed from view instantly
Sent to the server
Server checks the ID is a valid UUID
Row flagged as deleted and kept forever (no purge)
